turns.user: I'm taking a bus to the airport; does my ordinary single ticket work?
turns.agent:
It depends which airport bus you mean. An ordinary single ticket does not work on the 100E Airport Express. On the 200E, ordinary ticket and pass rules apply. Airport shuttle bus single ticket

The 5 November 2026 snapshot lists an ordinary single ticket at 500 HUF and a full-price 100E ticket at 2,500 HUF; those are snapshot prices, not live-verified fares. For current details, check BKK’s official pages. Which bus are you planning to take—100E or 200E?

Yes. An ordinary single ticket is valid on bus 200E under the ordinary ticket rules; it is not valid on 100E. The 5 November 2026 snapshot lists the ordinary single at 500 HUF. Single ticket Airport shuttle bus single ticket

That covers the 200E ride itself; if you transfer to another line, the ordinary single-ticket transfer rules may require another ticket. This is snapshot-based guidance, not live verification—check BKK’s current information before travel.
